description: Anonymised first-hand workshop repair records providing genuine E-E-A-T evidence

records.customer_reported_symptom: Shuddering vibration through the dashboard when pulling away in 1st gear and flashing spanner icon on instrument cluster.

diagnostic_findings.live_data: Clutch K1 adaptation thickness at lower limit (1.1mm); mechatronic accumulator pressure dropping below 42 bar after cold soak.
diagnostic_findings.physical_inspection: Micro-fracture detected in mechatronic lower valve body casting near accumulator thread.

records.confirmed_fault: Mechatronic accumulator pressure loss combined with secondary Clutch 1 friction disc wear.
records.work_completed: Mechatronic unit removed; upgraded reinforced steel accumulator sub-housing installed with fresh high-pressure hydraulic pump; dual dry-clutch pack replaced, shimmed with precision dial gauge, and basic adaptation relearn completed via ODIS.
parts_replaced: LUK Dual Dry Clutch Pack (DQ200 Gen 2)
records.outcome: Judder completely eliminated; hydraulic pressure holding stable at 52–60 bar; smooth pull-away confirmed on 12-mile road test.
